name: time-frequency analysis
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 研究信号时间与频率联合特征的方法。
usage_overview: 用于识别轨道不平顺或轮轨力信号的局部频率特征，并确定其出现位置或时刻，支持不平顺特征波长、病害波形及局部冲击的定位。处理沿线轨道数据时，以里程作为位置坐标。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the correlation between track irregularities and wheel/rail forces will be clarified from a viewpoint of frequency and quantificationally investigated by time-frequency energy densities (TFEDs) through an integrated time-frequency analysis approach.

But in the present work, an approach comprehensively developed by time-frequency analysis method and vehicle-track coupled dynamics has been investigated to further enrich the track irregularity analysis in time-frequency domain.

Pier settlement Transition zone High-speed railway Vehicle riding safety Rail deformation Time-frequency analysis A B S T R A C T The settlement of piers and subgrade bending deformation are widely recognized as common issues in the transition zones of high-speed railway bridges.
To further explore the rule between pier settlement and traffic safety, additional vertical rail irregularity simulation is added to the time-frequency analysis.

The theories of time-frequency analysis and energy mutation over characteristic waveforms were used to study the positioning and extraction of track irregularity characteristic wavelengths and track diseases.
